name: Dimethylpentylone
summary: Dipentylone (also known as dimethylpentylone or N,N-dimethylpentylone) is a substituted cathinone derivative with stimulant effects, which has been sold as a designer drug, first detected in Sweden in 2014.

pharmacology.text: Dipentylone is thought to be a prodrug of pentylone via N-dealkylation.
